G5-DET-FACTS-001.root_cause: Expired facts inherited unordered storage traversal when allocating removal event identity.
G5-DET-FACTS-001.fix: Sort expiration keys by type, subject and scope before publishing removal events.

G5-DET-FACTS-002.root_cause: Different messages with the same complete producer/batch/tick/local-sequence key had no deterministic tie breaker.
G5-DET-FACTS-002.fix: Reject duplicate complete worker ordering keys atomically rather than choosing an implicit hash/insertion order.

G5-DET-PHYSICS-001.root_cause: Equal-distance native and backend raycasts chose the first unordered body visited; bucket order affected the semantic hit.
G5-DET-PHYSICS-001.fix: Both raycast paths select the smallest stable body id at equal distance, including the first-hit sentinel boundary.

G5-HARNESS-ABILITY-RECONCILIATION-001.root_cause: Whole restore allowed resume without running Ability's existing restored-resource reservation reconciliation.
G5-HARNESS-ABILITY-RECONCILIATION-001.fix: Run ReconcileRestoredReservations when required inside the pre-resume reconciliation callback.

G5-EVIDENCE-COMPILED-SOURCE-001.root_cause: Matching executable hashes did not prove that cached receipts were compiled against the current scenario and engine source tree.
G5-EVIDENCE-COMPILED-SOURCE-001.fix: CMake generates a source-tree fingerprint embedded in the executable; every emitted scenario receipt must match the independently computed current fingerprint.
